search.label: Employee email
search.placeholder: Enter an employee email, e.g. name@company.com
search.notFound: No employee found for {{email}} — check the address and try again

empty.title: Enter an email to start the inventory
empty.body: See the assets they own (to transfer the Owner) and the assets of others they can access (to revoke the permission).

owned.title: Owned assets (Owner)
owned.desc: They are the Owner — transfer these to a new owner

access.title: Assets with access
access.desc: They hold a permission but are not the Owner — revoke these

priorityRule: Handover priority: High = P3 core asset, impact ≥ 10, or a failed task; Medium = P2 asset, L2 or above, or scheduled; everything else is Low.
idleRule: Idle: not used in the last {{days}} days — revoke these first.

transfer.title: Transfer assets
transfer.desc: Transfer {{count}} assets owned by {{name}} to new Owners. Each asset can go to a different person.
transfer.incomplete: Enter a valid recipient email for every asset
transfer.note: After the transfer the original employee is no longer the Owner. Downstream dependencies and other people's access are unchanged.

errors.self: Can't transfer to the current Owner
errors.inactive: This employee has left or is transferring and can't receive assets

revoke.title: Revoke access
revoke.desc: Revoke {{name}}'s access to the following {{count}} assets
revoke.note: Takes effect immediately; they lose access right away and would need to request it again.
